issue.title: test_legacy_no_commit_state_maps_to_approve_choice hits WaitForScreenTimeout under full-lane load
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_approve_options_modal_state.py::test_legacy_no_commit_state_maps_to_approve_choice`
- **Repro:** `just check` (6-worker full lane)

Proposed by sase-17d.12.2 note #10 (monitor j075kj66xtkd, ToolRun 181640206aaedbb9cd6afd796ecec0bd, 2026-09-25). The node failed with WaitForScreenTimeout under 6-worker load and passed in isolation on the same tree. Fail rate from that report: 1 full-lane failure, then a pass in isolation. Not caused by the spread-separator diff. The land agent did not re-run the full lane.
